statement.text:
The dimension of a partially ordered set ⟨P, ⩽⟩ is, by definition, the least
cardinal number δ such that the relation ⩽ is an intersection of δ relations of linear
order on P . Is it true that, for any Chernikov group which does not contain a direct
product of two quasicyclic groups over the same prime number, the subgroup lattice
has finite dimension? Expected answer: yes.                             L. N. Shevrin
